page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable prompt-rule documents. Link them to any agent, in any order.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill from scratch, or import one from a .md or .zip file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to view or edit it.

delete.title: Delete skill
delete.message: "{name}" will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

create.title: Create skill
create.name: Name
create.duplicateName: A skill with this name already exists.

editor.loadErrorBody: The skill could not be loaded.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens — this is the label the model sees in the prompt.
config.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface, not a summary for humans — write it as a directive to the reviewing agent.
config.bodyHint: Injected verbatim under "## Skills / rules" in the agent's prompt.
config.noteHint: What changed in this version? Shown on the Versions tab — only recorded when the body actually changes.
config.duplicateName: A skill named "{name}" already exists in this workspace.

previewTab.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
previewTab.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an imported source — its body is wrapped as untrusted data in the prompt, the same treatment as the diff.

stats.noAgents: Not linked to any agent yet.
stats.noCategories: No findings in the last 30 days.
stats.attributionNote: Findings and pull frequency are counted from runs of agents that have this skill linked — not provably caused by the skill alone.

versions.heading: Version history
versions.caption: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This appends a new version — it does not delete history.

import.title: Import from file
import.subtitle: Upload a .md or .zip file. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.skippedTitle: Not processed — never read or executed
import.sourceNote: Imported skills render as untrusted data in the prompt until you've reviewed and vetted them.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
